findings.title: Production agent responses exhaust the output cap
findings.verified: Latest six attempts: RESPONSE_INCOMPLETE / max_output_tokens, 900 output tokens each, no usable report. September 30 matching team latency = 54,030 ms. Offline mocked incomplete responses reproduce FAILED after six bounded attempts.
findings.smallest_fix: Authorize a focused budget-fit repair: measure and compact redundant evidence/request representation and establish response-fit checks for unchanged strict v2 outputs. Explicitly classify deterministic truncation instead of blindly retrying identical requests. Do not assume compaction alone proves live recovery; retain limits and grounding. Separate live authorization required for any later verification.
findings.after: Response headroom 1600, concise typed claims, budget preflight and OUTPUT_TRUNCATED diagnostics implemented; actual provider recovery is unconfirmed.

findings.title: FAILED becomes READY in team headline and reload
findings.verified: Real browser: all cards Failed while headline Ready to analyze the saved evidence. Mocked failed run -> result READY; restarted team -> health READY, despite durable failed ledgers. Health errors empty; last status is global, not snapshot-scoped.
findings.smallest_fix: Derive snapshot-specific last attempt state from durable records; render FAILED/PARTIAL/READY distinctly and expose a sanitized primary failure reason. Distinguish SUCCESS/COMPLETE from cache state.
findings.after: Durable snapshot-specific canonical team state; individual failures, partial and complete survive restart; UI and health consume the same state.

findings.title: Offline suite depends on ignored machine-local fixtures
findings.verified: Tracked-source mirror without synthetic_live_smoke_spec.json and instrument_master_cache.json: 2 assertion failures and 58 error/subtest entries. Restoring exact local copies: 183 pass / 0 fail / 1 skip. Final Phase 7/8 reports/contracts are tracked, but the synthetic smoke fixture is not.
findings.smallest_fix: Package only synthetic fixtures in a tracked fixture directory and mock the instrument-name dependency. No private runtime caches or real credentials should become test prerequisites.
findings.after: Tracked synthetic fixture replaces ignored smoke-spec dependency; instrument names mocked; production-sized payload and real local HTTP integration added.

findings.title: Agent snapshot validation checks identity, not temporal expiry
findings.verified: Unchanged snapshot with created_at in 2020 passes both current_agent_snapshot and preflight with matching synthetic saved hashes. Fusion separately evaluates evidence freshness, but paid agent execution has no age gate.
findings.smallest_fix: Add explicit forecast/source age policy before execution, with a labeled historical-analysis mode if needed; preserve content identity and existing fusion thresholds.
findings.after: Paid execution verifies current canonical pointer, content/forecast ownership and <=3600s snapshot/source age before each SDK attempt; historical result reads remain available.

findings.title: Pipeline health conflates operational health and research limitations
findings.verified: Intelligence DEGRADED is unconditional after a successful Gold completion solely because ensemble is research-only. Old DEGRADED stages are never converted to STALE. Web-news health is Tavily-only, not the whole Yahoo/RSS chain. Fusion health has no age expiry and also labels mixed/missing evidence as operational degradation.
findings.smallest_fix: Keep outcome, feature availability, freshness and operational status separate; scope health to current symbol/snapshot and disclose component-specific latency/cache state.
findings.after: Operational success is separate from research status/completeness. Old DEGRADED stages age to STALE; whole-chain news and snapshot-scoped fusion health are truthful. Unknown fallback latency is null.

findings.title: Public dashboard missing-file error exposes filesystem path
findings.verified: Actual handler, synthetic FileNotFoundError: GET /api/dashboard returns 400 containing C:\synthetic-private\outputs\forecast_summary.json. No real secret contents were requested.
findings.smallest_fix: Return stable public error codes/messages and keep any path detail in protected local diagnostics. Review equivalent explanation error handling.
findings.after: Non-domain exceptions receive generic public messages; trusted AgentError contracts remain structured. Synthetic path-bearing handler errors do not expose paths.

findings.title: New-request controls differ from saved-result identity
findings.verified: Saved RENTOMOJO.NS is correctly labeled in result/chart, but request field remains RELIANCE. Selecting 120 updates request helper while old 75-bar result remains visible. This is pending-request vs saved-result behavior, not a proven backend horizon defect.
findings.smallest_fix: Clarify new-request and saved-result labels without changing forecast values or forcing a new run.
findings.after: Saved ticker initializes request controls; pending 120-bar request is clearly distinguished from unchanged saved 75-bar result.

findings.title: Cold startup imports the heavy forecasting dependency path
findings.verified: Isolated server module import took 6.882 seconds; torch is CPU-only. Model weights were not loaded. Synchronous agent execution blocks that request while other server threads remain available.
findings.smallest_fix: Defer heavy imports only in a later authorized performance task; avoid broad restructuring during repair.
findings.after: Heavy imports and synchronous per-request work remain. Browser timeout is bounded, active state is visible, and other server threads remain available. No broad performance refactor.
